items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: And then he left to go and play with Sidney. I can't see, but that's Wayne. He played on a boat.

ctx.x: Right across the river. And he was trying to tell me why he came out. You see, he was working. He would, they sent him out to, he came out to work to help. You see? And he had to work in the field and he came out here. And I don't know how, I got him to start to play with him. He started to come and rehearse with us. And he started to play with me. And he started to play with me. About three years. And then he left to go and play with Sidney. I can't see, but that's Wayne. He played on a boat. He left me to go…
When did he start in with your band? About what year? Do you remember?
